name: Drizzled NIRCam mosaics, 9 filters
description: Drizzled multi-filter NIRCam mosaics of the GLIMPSE field on Abell S1063.
notes: Committed in the proposal for delivery 3 months after observation.

name: ICL and BCG subtracted NIRCam mosaics
description: NIRCam mosaics with the intracluster light and brightest cluster galaxy light subtracted (GALFIT, following Shipley et al. 2018).
notes: Committed in the proposal for delivery 6 months after observation.

name: HST mosaics of the field
description: HST mosaics of the Abell S1063 field, combined with the GLIMPSE NIRCam imaging.
notes: Not a proposal deliverable. The survey overview paper (arXiv:2511.07542) states that the first public data release includes reduced JWST and HST mosaics, photometric catalogs, and gravitational lensing models.

name: PSF-matched photometric catalog with photometric redshifts
description: PSF-matched multi-wavelength photometric catalog with EAZY / Bagpipes / BEAGLE photometric redshifts and SED fits, plus morphology.
notes: Committed in the proposal for delivery 9 months after observation.

name: Gravitational lens models: deflection, convergence and shear maps with uncertainties
description: Lens-model deflection, convergence, and shear maps of Abell S1063, with uncertainties.
notes: Committed in the proposal for delivery 9 months after observation.
